column1: # Certified observation set — tier=slow membership row (tiered checking,
# user directive 2026-08-08; docs/2026-08-04_membership-lane-design.md
# addendum of the same date). Quick runs verify samples + the
# driver-coupling pin against THIS set and its wire hash; scripts/ci
# --slow re-enumerates and must reproduce it exactly. Update
# deliberately, in its own commit, with the reason — never auto-written.
# certified: 2026-09-01  commit: T1 fidelity round, dc122857 (E8 fileOrder wire record)
# re-certification reason (T1 round, E8): the wire sha moved
#   (11aedfa0 -> 2f1d639f) because the program object now carries the
#   wire-level `fileOrder` record (T1 item 3, commit dc122857; latitude
#   inventory §E8) — schema widening ONLY, the exact class of the
#   2026-08-10 methodSets and BUG-067 variadic precedents. Verified
#   directly, not inferred: the merge-base frontend (main @ 95627141)
#   re-run on the unchanged fixture reproduces the OLD sha 11aedfa0
#   bit-for-bit, and the structural diff (jq -S) between that wire and
#   this branch's is EXACTLY the fileOrder addition
#   ({"package":"main","files":["main.go"]}) — nine lines, nothing
#   else; the A6 evaluation-order hoist does not touch this wire. The
#   fresh GOLEAN_SLOW=1 dedup enumeration reproduced the set AND the
#   graph bit-for-bit: the same six permutation members,
#   nodes=6193933 edges=6565663 dedupHits=371731, certified=checkCert.
#   Params unchanged. [AGENT] re-pin, delta class WIRE-SHA-ONLY.
# previously: certified: 2026-08-21  commit: holes arc BUG-067 (wire func types carry variadic)
# re-certification reason (holes arc, BUG-067): the wire sha moved
#   because EVERY func TYPE node now carries the required `variadic`
#   field (spec#Type_identity; docs/BUGS.md BUG-067) — schema widening
#   only, the 2026-08-10 methodSets precedent's exact class. The fresh
#   GOLEAN_SLOW=1 dedup enumeration reproduced the set AND the graph
#   bit-for-bit: the same six permutation members, nodes=6193933
#   edges=6565663 dedupHits=371731, certified=checkCert.
# width= NOTE — CORRECTED 2026-08-21 at the audit fix round (F4). The
#   text that stood here called the `width=` move from 16 to 4 "a
#   report-shape difference only". That was WRONG, and it explained away
#   the one thing worth reading. `width=` in the enum-stats line is the
#   enumerator's ECHO of the width it ran under. The PREVIOUS record
#   (the POR engine=dedup certification, `802a32de`, carried unchanged
#   through `9f307641`) declared `params: width=4` and echoed
#   `width=16` — so its enum-stats line was NOT produced by a run at
#   its own declared params. Every one of the seven pre-arc versions of
#   this record declares `width=4` in the params column; only those two
#   echo 16. This arc's re-certification RESOLVED the inconsistency:
#   the fresh run declares 4, echoes 4, and reproduces the previous
#   record's set AND graph counts bit-for-bit (re-verified here), so the
#   record is now self-consistent and its content is unchanged.
#   OPEN QUESTION, recorded honestly as moot-but-noted: what the OLD
#   record was actually certified under cannot be recovered from the
#   file — the echo says 16, the params say 4, and only one of them can
#   be what ran. It is MOOT because the current record was produced by a
#   run whose declared and echoed params agree and which reproduced the
#   graph exactly; it is NOTED because a params/echo mismatch is
#   precisely the shape a stale or mis-parameterized record takes, and
#   nothing in the gate compared those two fields at the time. (Under
#   engine=dedup the B-INFO note below is still right that `width=`
#   does not BOUND the claim — but "does not bound the claim" is not
#   "may disagree with the params it was run under", which is what had
#   happened.)
# previously: certified: 2026-08-21  commit: w32-por engine=dedup re-certification (atop 4f3036f5)
# re-certification reason (POR slice, docs/2026-08-21_w32-por-design.md):
#   the row moves to engine=dedup — the state-graph dedup engine + THE
#   VERIFIED CHECKER (checkCertM_slowObs), so this set is theorem-backed
#   EQUAL to SlowObs (the ∃-fuel ∃-stream image of execProgLoop) rather
#   than accountant/sentinel/ladder-guarded. The set is UNCHANGED: the
#   same six permutation members, reproduced by the dedup enumeration
#   (6,193,933 nodes / 6,565,663 edges, ~157 s dev-box wall vs the
#   pre-B1 DFS's 39.9M steps / 94 s; the post-B1 DFS tree was >900M
#   steps and INTRACTABLE — BUG-065, resolved for this row here). The
#   stage-C recorded witness streams for all six members cross-check.
#   Wire sha unchanged. Params: +engine=dedup (tier=slow retained: the
#   fast lane stays on this cached record; --slow re-certifies).
# previously: certified: 2026-08-10  commit: spec-parity arc-end class-closure round
# re-certification reason (class-closure round, 2026-08-10): the wire
#   sha moved because EVERY wire now carries the required methodSets
#   field (BUG-053 class closure,
#   docs/2026-08-10_method-set-record-contract.md) — schema widening
#   only; the fresh enumeration reproduced the set AND the stats
#   bit-for-bit (observations=6, steps=39976295).
# previously: certified: 2026-08-09  commit: spec-parity-s1 audit-fix round (assignment-spine step growth; work cap raised)
# re-certification reason (S1 audit major, gates dimension): the
#   BUG-034/037/025 spine migrations alone had already pushed the
#   enumeration past the old work=40000000 cap (the audit reproduced
#   the breach at 390ed13c, BEFORE the BUG-052 reorder; the reorder
#   only re-times existing steps) (fail-loud abort with
#   subtrees unexplored — the default gate's CERTIFIED-CACHED path
#   could not see it). Cap raised to 60000000 in cases.tsv (same
#   commit); re-enumerated FULLY under GOLEAN_SLOW=1 at the new cap:
#   the set is COMPLETE and still exactly the six permutation members
#   with identical values (cardinality re-checked, not assumed — the
#   spine adds steps but no scheduling sites, and the fresh
#   enumeration confirms it). Wire sha unchanged. Prior re-cert
#   (same date): F15 kind-carrying observation shape.
# case: imported-goose/channel/google-search

#   `execProgLoop` — with no width or site restriction. They are kept in
#   the row so a revert to the DFS engine has its parameters, and
